name: Vidu
summary: AI video generator for text, image and reference-to-video, with its own Vidu models and API.
description: Vidu generates videos from text prompts, images and reference images, keeping characters consistent across shots, and also creates images. It runs on its own Vidu Q-series models and offers templates, an agent, an API platform and a creator programme. A Free plan is available; paid plans start at $10 per month ($8.25 per month billed yearly) with 800 monthly credits.

howToUse.title: Open Vidu
howToUse.description: Open Vidu. A Free plan exists. Paid plans start at $10 per month, or $8.25 per month when billed yearly, and they include 800 monthly credits.

howToUse.title: Generate a video
howToUse.description: Pick Text to Video, Image to Video, or Reference to Video. A Q-series model generates the video from your prompts or your images, including reference images.

howToUse.title: Keep the character consistent
howToUse.description: Reference images are for keeping characters consistent across shots.

howToUse.title: Use templates, the agent, or the API
howToUse.description: From there, Vidu offers templates, an agent, an API platform, and a creator programme you can join.
